e: Prime Minister Schmidt apologizes for making a Nazi salute in 2007.
A child is reported missing aboard the MV Lady Samoa III but is found safe before the ferry arrives at Mulifanua.
The Samoa Swim Series, an open water swimming competition, is held as part of the national sports calendar.
The Indonesia women's national under-18 basketball team defeats Samoa 94–49 in the quarter-finals of the 2026 FIBA U-18 Asia Cup Division B in Bangkok, Thailand.
The Samoa national netball team plays a friendly series against the Australian U-23 team at Tuana'imato Sports Complex, Apia.
The U.S. Marine Minerals Administration announces the revocation of deep-sea mining permits in waters near American Samoa following opposition from Pacific communities.

A policy dialogue titled Governance for Resilient Futures is held at Taumeasina Island Resort, Apia, organized by the UNDP and the Government of Samoa to discuss climate resilience and economic pressures.
Police in Apia launch an investigation into the involvement of two Samoan nationals in the killing of Lorenzo Lemalu.
Vietnamese police charge two Samoan nationals with killing the Australian Coconut Cartel leader Lorenzo Lemalu and wounding an associate in Ho Chi Minh City.
